summary: Sketch dimensions are drawn where they are placed, and can be moved. With the Dimension tool, a click, Enter or a menu command places a dimension exactly where its preview drew it at the pointer, and before the pointer has been over the sketch Enter places it in its usual position; a point to line distance now previews its dimension line along the line at the pointer. Placing on geometry that already has the dimension selects that dimension and moves it to where the preview drew it, in its own sector or on its own side, in the same undo step as any relation that keeps it measuring the picks. Dimensions one click places, such as both distances of a point from the axes, are stepped apart until their values are clear of each other, in the preview as in the sketch. In Select, dragging a dimension's value moves it: a distance's value along its dimension line and away from the geometry, an angle's along its arc and away from the corner, and a radius or diameter's round the center and in or out, inside or outside the curve. Dragging the dimension line, or an angle's arc, moves only the line or arc, and the text keeps its place along it; a point to line distance's line slides along the line. Each chamfer setback moves on its own. Text taken past an extension line, or past the end of an angle's arc, extends the line or arc to reach it, with the arrows where they were. A press that moves 4 px or less is still a click, so click, double-click, Delete and the menu work as before. While a dimension is dragged, only that dimension is drawn again, in an overlay, and nothing is solved; the release is one undo step that changes only where the dimension is drawn, never geometry, the build or output, and selects the dragged dimension; it checks only the new placement, so the sketch is not checked, compiled or solved again. Escape, or a lost pointer, during the drag puts it back and keeps the selection. The dimension menu gains Reset position, which returns a moved dimension to its usual position, and with several moved dimensions selected reads Reset N positions; it is disabled, with its reason, for a dimension laid out automatically. Where a dimension is drawn is saved with the sketch, relative to the geometry it measures, so it follows the geometry when it moves, resizes or is solved again, through Move selection, Extend, Trim, Linear pattern, Offset loop, Use reference, undo and redo; an edit that turns a line round keeps the dimensions placed along it where they were drawn; Make reference and Make driving keep it, and a Mirror copy does not copy dimensions. Every dimension takes a placement: aligned, horizontal and vertical distances, lengths, point to line distances, distances from an axis, angles and the leader of an angle across near-parallel lines, radius and diameter, fillets, chamfer setbacks, references and dimensions driven by parameters. A placement that no longer fits what its dimension measures is kept but drawn in the usual position. A dimension at 0 length, such as a distance a parameter takes to 0 or a point on the line it is measured from, moves along its line and away from it like any other, and is drawn as a dimension a hair long is, so its value stays where it was put as the length passes through 0. Agents read the placement as a relation's optional annotation and set it with the existing set-sketch-relation edit; cad_describe_features names the sketch schema's repeated schemas once under $defs.
warning: Potentially breaking for CAD files: a document whose sketch has a placed dimension cannot be opened by release 0.0.784 or earlier, because their strict relation schemas reject the new optional annotation field. Existing documents are not migrated or rewritten, and a dimension gains a placement only when a person places it with the pointer on the sketch, drags it, or an agent sets one; one placed from the keyboard alone, or reset, carries none. Potentially breaking for agents and automation: relations read through cad_get_feature, cad_read_features and cad_read_document can carry annotation, so readers that reject unknown fields must accept it, and exact comparisons of a dimension placed with the pointer on the sketch, by a click, Enter or a menu command, must allow it. cad_describe_features(kind="sketch") now returns its schema with CadScalar, CadIdentifier and the four placement schemas under $defs, referred to elsewhere as {"$ref": name}; agents that read that schema must resolve each $ref. A press-and-drag that starts on a dimension's value, line or arc in Select now moves that dimension, where it did nothing. The Dimension tool's status for geometry that is already dimensioned reads This is already dimensioned. Placing selects that dimension and moves it where the preview shows it, and, where a relation is added, This is already dimensioned. Placing selects that dimension, moves it where the preview shows it and adds the relation that keeps it measuring these picks; automation that matches the old texts must use the new ones. The dimension menu has a new Reset position item between Make reference or Make driving and Delete. A dimension at 0 length is now drawn as one a hair long is: a distance or a distance from an axis with its value beside its leader, reading along the direction it measures, and a point to line distance whose point lies on its line with its value beside the point, reading square to the line; automation that reads where those values are drawn must allow for it. No breaking change for installed posts, machine packages, saved revisions or controller output.

checklist.schema: CAD schema 2 sketch graph dimension relations gain an optional annotation: {kind: linear, offset, along} for distance, axis-distance, fixed-axis, point-line-distance and line-angle (its leader), {kind: angle, radius, along} for line-angle, {kind: radial, angle, distance} for radial-size and fillet-corner, {kind: setbacks, sides: [{offset, along} | null, {offset, along} | null]} for chamfer-corner, and linear or radial for reference-dimension, which must fit its measurement: radial for a radial size, linear otherwise, or parsing rejects with invalid-sketch-annotation. Offsets and distances are bounded by 1e6 mm, along by 1e4, an angle radius is above 0 and a radial angle lies within -π to π; extra and missing fields reject under the strict schemas. The field is additive and optional, so documents without it are unchanged, but the strict relation union means release 0.0.784 and earlier reject a document that contains it: the minimum reader is 0.0.785. There is no schema version bump, migration or rewrite. No UPID, post, machine package, execution plan, saved revision, storage, journal, worker reply or native buffer protocol change; the Rust solver and committed WebAssembly module are unchanged. Post engine API remains 1 and saved-job engine remains 3.
checklist.events: No execution event or input-version behavior change. A placement is display only: no solver, analysis, kernel build or output reads it. A batch that differs from the accepted sketch only in placement is checked for its placements alone and keeps the accepted sketch's geometry, certificates, prepared drawing, snaps, viewport references and analysis, with no check, compile or solve of the sketch; the kernel model key leaves placement out, so the solid is not rebuilt; and the constraint status reuses the analysis of the previous version when the next version differs from it only in placement. A drag runs no solver and edits nothing until release: it hides the dragged dimension and lays out only that one in a moving overlay, from a moving store the rest of the canvas does not read, so the other dimensions, the geometry and the sketch canvas are not rendered on pointer moves. The press captures the pointer; 4 px of movement with the primary button held starts the drag; the click that follows a drag is swallowed; Escape, captured on the window, and a lost or cancelled pointer drop the drag without an edit. No move starts during a geometry pick or a point drag, and a release is dropped when the accepted relation has changed apart from its placement since the press. The release submits one set-sketch-relation edit with the new placement through the same prepared, cancellable, version-checked edit path as other canvas edits. Reset position submits the selected dimensions without their placement in one edit. The Dimension tool stores the placement its preview drew at the pointer, for a click, Enter or a menu command alike; with no pointer position yet it stores none. The preview and the stored placements come from one layout of the dimensions the click adds and those it moves, each in the sector, side and frame of its own relation, and a dimension whose value would overlap one placed earlier by the same click steps out from what it measures until it is clear, up to 12 steps. Placements follow the geometry because they are stored relative to it, and Make reference and Make driving carry the placement to the converted relation, reversing a linear one whose point order the conversion reverses. Trim swaps a chamfer's setback placements when it swaps the chamfer's lines; an edit that swaps a line's ends turns each point to line distance, driving or reference, and each reference length placed along that line and carried over unchanged round with it, negating its offset and taking its along from the other end, while a placement the edit states is kept as given and a sketch draft that restates one publishes it exactly; separation of overlapping labels never moves a placed dimension. Relation marks lie beneath dimension lines and text in both paint and pick order, so a drag that starts on a dimension drawn over a mark moves the dimension and leaves the mark unselected.
checklist.capabilities: No post or machine capability change. Dimension relations gain an optional placement, and every dimension kind can be placed with the Dimension tool, moved by its value or line in Select and reset from its menu. cad_edit_document accepts the annotation through the existing set-sketch-relation edit and validates it before the controller is called; reads return it; no WebMCP tool is added or removed. cad_describe_features(kind="sketch") names CadScalar, CadIdentifier and the four placement schemas once under $defs, which keeps the sketch definition within the reply budget. The set-sketch-relation description gains a sentence on the annotation. The shared UI components and theme are unchanged.
checklist.auditAndOutput: No generation, audit, numbering, encoding, line ending, feed or controller-file change.
checklist.installationAndStorage: No installed package, revision, browser-cache or folder storage format change. Placements are saved inside the sketch relations of the CAD document in the browser cache and folder adapters alike; a document saved with one needs this release or later. Saved documents without placements open unchanged.

publicNotes.summary: Sketch dimensions stay where you place them, and you can drag them.
changes: With Dimension, the dimension is placed exactly where its preview shows it, whether you click, press Enter or choose from the menu.
Placing on geometry that already has the dimension selects that dimension and moves it to the preview.
When one click places several dimensions, their values are spaced apart, as the preview shows.

In Select, drag a dimension's value to move it along its line and away from the geometry, an angle's along its arc, and a radius or diameter round its center. Drag the dimension line or arc to move only the line.
Text dragged past an extension line extends the dimension line to reach it. Each chamfer setback moves on its own.
A drag is one undo step that changes no geometry. Press Escape during a drag to put the dimension back.
Reset position in the dimension menu returns a moved dimension to its usual position, and resets all the selected ones at once.

Where a dimension is drawn is saved with the sketch and follows its geometry through moves, trims, patterns, offsets, Make reference and Make driving. Reversing a line keeps the dimensions placed along it where they were.
A dimension at 0 length can be dragged along and away from its line like any other, and keeps its place as its length passes through 0.
publicNotes.compatibility: Sketches with a placed dimension cannot be opened by release 0.0.784 or earlier. Existing documents are not changed. Installed machine packages, posts, saved revisions and controller output are unchanged.
publicNotes.action: Keep release 0.0.784 or earlier away from documents saved after placing or moving a dimension, or reset those dimensions first. Automation that drags in Select over a dimension, matches the Dimension status for already-dimensioned geometry, or compares dimension relations exactly must allow for placements; agents that read cad_describe_features(kind="sketch") must resolve $ref against $defs.
